title: Law to require outreach on a voucher homeownership program
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to run an education and outreach campaign informing Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher participants about the Housing Choice Voucher Homeownership program. The campaign would need to cover eligibility requirements and application procedures, begin within 90 days of enactment, and provide materials in English and all designated citywide languages through mailings and in-person events.
